name: duopore-public-job-search-capacity-plan
description: See how many job search tasks fit into the time you have this week.
keywords: fit job search into your week

interface.shortDescription: Fit job search into your week
interface.longDescription: See how many job search tasks fit into the time you have this week. Choose tasks, time per task, target counts and your priority order. The app fits whole tasks into your available minutes and shows what must wait. For adults planning their own search. It does not choose employers or predict how many applications will succeed.
capabilities: Fit job search into your week
defaultPrompt: Plan my job search tasks around these available minutes.
Which application tasks fit this week and which must wait?

positive.prompt: Use Job Search Capacity Plan with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"weeklyMinutes":120,"tasks":[{"task":"Tailor application","minutesEach":45,"target":3,"priority":1},{"task":"Review vacancy facts","minutesEach":15,"target":2,"priority":2}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts.
